escena: SCENE (a bare dark stage seen straight on at platform height): a THREE-STEP winners' podium made of matte dark metal stands centred on the floor — clearly a podium, unmistakable at a glance. All three steps are OCCUPIED by identical small glowing markers, and a hard beam of light from above bathes the podium. Down on the floor BESIDE the podium, outside the beam and in shadow, stands the small Clawd figure from the reference, turned towards the lit podium it is not standing on. Running across the floor in front of the podium, lying flat and glowing, is a long horizontal SEARCH BAR — a rounded rectangular slot glowing softly from within, completely EMPTY except for one thin vertical text cursor at its left end. No letters, no numbers, no words, no icons — the podium is what the search bar produced. The beam and the bar are the ONLY light; everything else falls to deep navy black. Fine dust in the beam. 50mm at f/2.8. NOTHING may read as old or analogue: NO books, NO paper, NO plants, NO mugs, NO clutter anywhere, including out of focus. Current-generation hardware only: anodised aluminium, matte glass, seamless edges, bezel-less screens. Bare desk. Empty architectural darkness behind.

texto.muro: the empty dark space above the podium, unbroken and unlit

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the stage floor in the immediate foreground, running unbroken across the whole width
lecho.tono: DARK near-black matte floor in deep shadow, outside the light
